title: Our SharePoint site is giving 'Access Denied'
description: I can't access the HR department's SharePoint site, I get a 'Sorry, you don't have access' warning.

worklogs.description: User was not found in the site permissions list.
Approval obtained from the site owner, user added to the 'Members' group.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: You've been added to Site Members. Access will be available within 5-10 minutes.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: It's open now, I can access the files, thanks.

resolutionNote: User added to the HR SharePoint site Members group. Access confirmed.
